title: Gambit rules component diagram
description: The rules of chess in GDScript, for the board in the game: squares 0..63, pieces as ints, moves packed into an int. The server judges online games with chess.js (shared/rules.ts); this is the same rules on the client, tested against the standard perft counts by godot/tests/test_rules.gd.

components.name: Chess rules (rules.gd)
components.responsibility: The global class Chess: no scene tree, no I/O.

components.name: Positions and moves
components.responsibility: Chess.Position, start() and from_fen(), attack detection, pseudo-legal and legal_moves(), make(), UCI and SAN, repetition keys, insufficient material and perft.

components.name: Game record (Chess.Game)
components.responsibility: A game as its UCI moves, with every position, the SAN of each move and the result the board decides (mate, stalemate, material, threefold repetition, fifty moves); describe() puts a result in words.

relationships.description: Static functions and the Position class.
parse_uci, san, make and legal_moves for each move played, then judges the new position.
